column1: # Footprint budget for the edge guard (server/edge_footprint_test.go, scripts/edge/footprint.sh).
# One row per <goos>/<goarch> and build profile (full; airgap = -tags noaws,noazure,nogcp).
# "-" means no budget yet: a missing binary budget FAILS the test, a missing RSS
# budget skips it with a message (RSS needs a baseline measured ON that platform).
# The binary is the release build (CGO_ENABLED=0 -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w").
# The RSS is the peak resident size of a freshly initialised SQLite server that
# has been up and idle for a few seconds (start-up spike included), in KiB.
# Each budget is the value measured when the guard was added plus about 20%. It
# is a tripwire for accidental growth, not a target: when growth is intended,
# raise the row in the PR that causes it and say why. Refresh the measured values
